summary: United Maritime Corporation filed a Form 6-K reporting results of its 2026 Annual Meeting of Shareholders held November 4, 2026. Shareholders elected Ms. Christina Anagnostara and Mr. Ioannis Kartsonas as Class A Directors serving until the 2029 Annual Meeting, and ratified the appointment of Ernst Young (Hellas) Certified Auditors Accountants S.A. as independent auditors for fiscal year ending December 31, 2026. No transaction, stake, price, or structural terms are disclosed. The filing is a routine meeting-results notice incorporated by reference into the company's Form F-3 registration statements; no deal or risk-arb angle applies.
